name: Nevada Distribution & Control
old_description: After working for wholesalers for many years, I decided to open this business in 1998 to offer customers personal service and excellent products for less. My many industry contacts trust in me and know that I’ll provide top-tier products and services for their needs.
about:
Nevada Distribution & Control was founded in 1998 in Las Vegas, Nevada, by an owner who had previously worked for wholesalers. The owner opened the business to offer personal service and excellent products at lower prices, leveraging industry contacts built over years.

The company specializes in the sale of new, reconditioned, and obsolete circuit breakers, along with a range of electrical components including bus plugs, motor controls, mounting hardware, panelboard switches, and transformers. It also purchases excess inventory from industrial and commercial clients nationwide. Operations include testing and repair of electrical equipment performed by certified AVO® technicians, 24-hour emergency service, and next-day or same-day delivery via UPS, FedEx, and motor freight. The inventory comprises thousands of SKUs across major brands such as Eaton, Siemens, Square D, and Westinghouse, with no minimum or maximum order requirements. All reconditioned products carry a two-year warranty.

Nevada Distribution & Control serves industrial and commercial customers across the United States, including contractors, maintenance departments, and facility managers who need reliable circuit protection and electrical parts. The company reports a customer base of over 3,000 clients.

The founder’s stated vision is to provide personal service and excellent products for less. The company emphasizes its large, ever-changing inventory, certified technicians, rapid delivery options, and a no-minimum-order policy as key differentiators.
